note: SYNTHETIC DEMO PROFILE. Replace this file with any business's real, approved information.
name: Demo Co-op Nyeri
location: Main road, 2 km from the market centre, Nyeri County, Kenya

coffee_intake.cherry_delivery_hours: 07:00 to 15:00 on weekdays during harvest season
coffee_intake.rule: Cherry must be delivered on the day it is picked. Each delivery is weighed and recorded against the member number.

payments.schedule: Members are paid monthly, on the 15th, by mobile money
payments.advance: Members can request an advance of up to 30 percent of their recorded deliveries
payments.statement: Members can get a delivery statement free of charge at the office

services.name: Fertiliser on credit
services.details: Order at the office before the 5th of the month

services.name: Seedling sales
services.details: Improved varieties, available March to May

services.name: Agronomy visit
services.details: Book at the office; an extension officer visits within 2 weeks

services.name: Coffee drying and milling
services.details: All delivered cherry is processed at the co-op factory

membership.who_can_join: Any coffee farmer in Nyeri County
membership.documents: National ID and proof of land use
membership.how: Visit the office during opening hours

contact.office: Visit the office, or press zero on this line to request a call back from an officer

policies: The co-op never asks for passwords or mobile money PINs.
Price information is a reference only; each farmer decides whether to sell.
